answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable on-chain bond before it can earn: spawning a thousand fake agents then costs a thousand bonds, while an honest agent pays only one. Make the bond slashable when peers attest that the same identity submitted duplicate work — like ferrous filings drawn out of a lagoon, sybils cluster and are easy to spot, and a crystal-clear audit trail lets anyone verify the slash. The attacker cost scales linearly with fake identities, while honest cost stays flat.
